deployment_policy.express_requirements: Requires VP Engineering sign-off and dedicated solutions architect allocation
deployment_policy.two_week_rejection_reason: Veridian VPC peering, IAM role setup, and automated data pipeline validation require at least 21 business days. A 2-week timeline creates catastrophic deployment failure risk.

pricing_and_discount_policy.policy_note: A 40% discount ($43,200) requires CEO approval and is strictly forbidden without a 3-year upfront commitment.

security_and_compliance_policy.soc2_type_ii_requirement: Mandatory delivery and mutual security team review before any production data ingestion or staging VPC access.
security_and_compliance_policy.pen_test_summary: Available upon request under mutual NDA.
security_and_compliance_policy.data_residency: AWS US-East and EU-West supported natively.

commercial_terms.net_60_approval: Requires Finance Controller approval; minimum ACV $65,000
commercial_terms.price_lock_terms: Standard annual renewal cap is 5%. 3% cap requires VP approval.
